filename.epoch_source: current kernel UTC captured immediately at first create attempt; no validity, monotonicity, or RTC correction gate
filename.range_status: derived from 32-bit signed time_t plus truncated nonnegative nanoseconds; compile-time assertion required after exact headers acquired

record.durability_boundary: sync empty inode, then parent directory; reason write/sync occurs separately and best-effort on same inode
record.count_rule: safe matching regular inode counts regardless of zero length, partial reason, reason syntax, mtime, ownership, or mode
record.reason_rule: bounded one-line diagnostic; raw SRC availability/value and cumulative decoded bits only; unknown stays unknown; contents never authority

scope.count: canonical matching names whose lstat target is regular file; never follow symlink
scope.reset: delete only same canonical safe regular files; parent-directory sync after deletion

baseline.first_install_selection: before any mutation, T02 captures directory absence/presence, every immediate entry, file bytes, symlink target, uid/gid/mode/timestamps, hard-link identity, ACLs, xattrs, capabilities; unsafe ambiguity rejects install
baseline.upgrade_rule: first baseline immutable across upgrade/reinstall/failure; later package versions consume same baseline, never replace it with mutated state
baseline.uninstall_rule: T02 lifecycle contract must restore exact first baseline and remove package-created namespace objects only after module absence; preserve unrelated paths; any mismatch quarantines image

selection.since: parsed signed epoch-ms >= request lower bound; inclusive UTC

status: semantic contract frozen; kernel implementation blocked by platform.json gates
